summary: Expanded the universe around transmission-line hardware and installation-enabling components using a two-lane funnel. The cleanest underfollowed public-market mapping is Preformed Line Products, which directly manufactures transmission/distribution dead-ends, splices, suspension/support hardware, OPGW/ADSS accessories, and related line products. Hubbell is the diversified reference anchor for utility components. AZZ is a second-order underfollowed exposure through galvanizing and metal coatings used in transmission/distribution infrastructure. MYR Group is not a hardware supplier but is included as a demand/customer-proxy reference for line construction starts and procurement timing. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
